description: Body of the POST request to the quotes endpoint. It MUST NOT contain any data identifying the rider.

address.description: Full address, so it does not get lost during reverse geocoding.

pickup.description: Location where the rider will be picked up.

address.description: Full address, so it does not get lost during reverse geocoding.

drop_off.description: Location where the rider will be dropped off.

brand_ids.description: Service brand IDs from service_brands.json to limit the quotes to.

riders.description: Number of riders travelling, including the requester and any personal care attendant.

mobility_aid.description: Mobility aid used by the rider, from the TOMP-API mobilityNeed vocabulary.

stays_in_mobility_aid.description: true if the rider cannot transfer to a seat and travels seated in the mobility aid.

mobility_aid_weight.description: Weight of the mobility aid including its occupant, in kilograms.

mobility_aid_width.description: Width of the mobility aid, in centimetres.

mobility_aid_length.description: Length of the mobility aid, in centimetres.

service_animal.description: true if a service animal travels with the rider.

personal_care_attendants.description: Number of personal care attendants travelling with the rider, counted in riders.

boarding_assistance.description: true if the rider needs the driver's help to board.

notes.description: Free text describing needs the other fields do not cover.
